_note: skill-creator format (https://agentskills.io/skill-creation/evaluating-skills). Each scenario replays canned runlens output from evals/files/<scenario>/commands.md, so the branches of the retro can be tested without a database. The JSON shapes of score/versions/proposals/verify follow the CLI contract (runlens score|versions|verify --json) and must be kept in step with it; fields a scenario does not need are left out. tests/test_retro_fixtures.py checks every commands.md against the output of the real CLI on the demo database.
